performance.raw_unit: evaluation ratio to fastest successful comparison member

engine.name: OptiProfiler
engine.render_adapter: Disable _draw_problem_history_plot only; score_only reload otherwise forces unnecessary history rendering

score_definition.aggregation: official default mean history performance score over tolerances; never across tasks or snapshots
score_definition.normalization: per tolerance/profile type: area divided by largest member area; zero maximum uses 1
score_definition.threshold: max(tol*f0 + (1-tol)*fbest, fbest), per cell; exact OptiProfiler nonfinite conventions

tasks.label: Noisy observations
limitations: Not a controlled identical-prompt or identical-time-limit treatment; normal 300s runs retained by owner policy.
Scores are comparison-relative areas, not success probabilities; adding members requires recomputation.
Only history-based scores are published; wrapper history-best is not an agent-return score.
Provider-side model identity is not independently attested.
Archive sources remain private; public numerical derivatives do not expose raw agent logs.
Exact hash-bound zero-evaluation agent failures remain in the 920-cell denominator with no invented observations. They are distinct from normal completion and ordinary timeout.

parameters.budget_policy: archived first B=50*n clean objective observations; no post-budget evaluations

reference.target: per problem/repetition minimum of canonical initial merit and all member budgeted histories
